weather_label: hindcast with observed weather - upper bound on live skill
notes: LightGBM's test fit is retrained on data through 2024 (walk-forward); the EA-LSTM is trained on 2016-2023 only (2024 = early stopping), so on test LightGBM has one more year of training data.
Spatial holdout: the EA-LSTM never saw these reaches; LightGBM variant A was trained on them (reach_id feature) - not a like-for-like comparison.
seasonal_naive is a point forecast: no interval, no calibration, CRPS = MAE.

gate.rule: ealstm+assim beats lightgbm+assim on validation CRPS in >= 2 of 3 buckets for every target, with |coverage_80 - 0.80| no worse (+0.0)

unassimilated_comparison.rule: ealstm beats lightgbm on validation CRPS in >= 2 of 3 buckets for every target, with |coverage_80 - 0.80| no worse (+0.0)

attribution_sanity.status: not computed: EA-LSTM is not production (SHAP from LightGBM is served)
